title: Kshetra Kshetrajna Vibhaga Yoga
translation: The Yoga of Discrimination between the Field and the Knower of the Field
summary: Krishna explains the distinction between the physical body (the field) and the immortal soul (the knower of the field), and the nature of knowledge that leads to liberation.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
इदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते |
एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः || १ ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: This body, O son of Kunti, is called the field, and one who knows this body is called the knower of the field.
verses.transliteration:
śrī-bhagavān uvāca
idaṁ śarīraṁ kaunteya kṣetram ity abhidhīyate
etad yo vetti taṁ prāhuḥ kṣetrajña iti tadvidaḥ
verses.meaning: Idam - this; Shariram - body; Kaunteya - O son of Kunti; Kshetram - the field...
